SharkDown is designed to respect your privacy. The app does not collect, store, or transmit your personal data to the developer.

Your documents, themes and settings stay on your device, in your own iCloud account if you use iCloud, or wherever you choose to keep them. iCloud sync is provided by Apple, under Apple's privacy policy. The developer of SharkDown does not receive, store, or process any of this content.

SharkDown's AI tools use Apple Intelligence's on-device model. Your text is processed on your device and is not sent to the developer or to any other service. On devices without Apple Intelligence, the AI tools don't appear.

SharkDown does not include analytics, tracking frameworks, or third-party data collection services. It only goes online to sync your documents and settings through your own iCloud account, and to show images your documents link to on the web.
SharkDown+, the standalone version, periodically checks sharkfood.com for updates. This is a standard HTTPS request and does not include any personal data.

SharkDown does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children. Because the app does not collect or transmit user data to the developer, no personal information is stored by the developer.
This privacy policy may be updated from time to time. Any updates will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.
